query:
SELECT 
  p.id,
  p.name as project_name,
  p.status,
  p.contractType,
  p.totalPrice,
  p.estimatedDuration,
  p.revisionNumber,
  p.createdAt,
  p.updatedAt,
  u.name as user_name,
  u.email as user_email
FROM projects p
JOIN users u ON p.userId = u.id
ORDER BY p.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 20;
